subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should the stranded-final recovery for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85714 land as this PR's opt-in `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` mode, as successor https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99536's default guarded recovery, or stay warning-only for now?
rationale: The branch changes a documented privacy-sensitive delivery contract and adds a user-visible config surface, which is a product policy choice separate from the mechanical sanitizer defect.

options.title: Prefer Sanitized Default Recovery
options.body: Use the successor shape or update this branch so the narrow stranded-final class recovers by default with sanitized text and no new config knob.

options.title: Keep Opt-In Recovery
options.body: Accept the new config surface only after sanitizing retry text and documenting that operators intentionally opt into replaying private finals through one retry.

options.title: Stay Warning-Only
options.body: Reject automatic recovery for now and keep `message_tool_only` as a strict private-final contract with operator diagnostics only.

recommendation.title: Prefer Sanitized Default Recovery
recommendation.body: Use the successor shape or update this branch so the narrow stranded-final class recovers by default with sanitized text and no new config knob.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the merged warning-only baseline and the decision is about repository-wide delivery/privacy policy, not only a local code repair.
